sloka: ऊर्ध्व बाहुः निरालंबो वायु भक्षः तपः चरन् ।धर्मे पंच तपा भूत्वा वर्षासु आकाश संश्रयः ॥१-६३-२३॥
transliteration: ūrdhva bāhuḥ nirālaṁbo vāyu bhakṣaḥ tapaḥ caran ।dharme paṁca tapā bhūtvā varṣāsu ākāśa saṁśrayaḥ ॥1-63-23॥

translations.english: After the departure of the gods, mighty ascetic Viswamitra raised his arms up, stood without support, subsisting on air, continuing with his austerities.
